chunks.arabic_text: أَبِي رَحِمَهُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلْحِمْيَرِيُّ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ ع قَالَ

translations.en: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us both, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

chunks.arabic_text: إِنَّ شِيعَةَ عَلِيٍّ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ كَانُوا خُمْصَ ٱلْبُطُونِ ذُبُلَ ٱلشِّفَاهِ وَ أَهْلَ رَأْفَةٍ وَ عِلْمٍ وَ حِلْمٍ يُعْرَفُونَ بِٱلرَّهْبَانِيَّةِ فَأَعِينُوا عَلَى مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْوَرَعِ وَ ٱلِاجْتِهَادِ

translations.en: Indeed, the Shia of Ali (peace be upon him) were those with atrophied stomachsophied bellies and dry lips, and people of compassion, knowledge, and forbearance. They were known for their asceticism (rahbaniyyah). So assist in what you are upon with piety and diligence.

en.summary: This hadith describes the physical and spiritual characteristics of the early Shia of Imam Ali (peace be upon him), noting their asceticism (indicated by atrophied stomachs and dry lips from fasting) and their virtues of compassion, knowledge, and forbearance. It exhorts believers to support their faith and state by cultivating piety (war') and diligence (ijtihad).
en.seo_question: What are the defining characteristics of the Shia of Ali according to this hadith?

key_terms.خُمْصَ ٱلْبُطُونِ: Atrophied or lean bellies, indicating fasting and asceticism
key_terms.ذُبُلَ ٱلشِّفَاهِ: Dry lips, indicating lack of moisture from fasting or speaking little
key_terms.ٱلرَّهْبَانِيَّةِ: Asceticism or monastic devotion, denoting a life of worship and piety
key_terms.ٱلْوَرَعِ: Piety or God-consciousness, specifically avoiding doubtful matters
key_terms.ٱلِاجْتِهَادِ: Diligence or striving, often referring to intellectual or spiritual effort in religious matters
